counterfactual_missing_items: no evidence of lung cancer on biopsy
decisive_items: necrotizing granulomatous inflammation without evidence of malignancy
cytoplasmic ANCA titre of 1 / 20 and a PR3 level of 14.6 IU ml−1
response.rationale: The presence of cytoplasmic ANCA and PR3, along with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation, strongly supports Wegener's granulomatosis, while the biopsy results rule out lung cancer and the clinical presentation is not typical for tuberculosis or methotrexate-induced lung disease.

rejected.why: biopsy results did not support lung cancer diagnosis
methotrexate-induced lung disease is less likely given the overall clinical picture
biopsy results did not support tuberculosis diagnosis
